FMAG.description: Moment Magnification Factors (FMAG). Fields are the first- and second-order moment magnification factors about the Y and Z axes, each constrained to 1.0 <= value < 100.0.

B1Y_DELTA_BY.description: B1y - Delta by (First Order Moment magnification factor about Y). Must satisfy 1.0 <= value < 100.0.

B1Z_DELTA_BZ.description: B1z - Delta bz (First Order Moment magnification factor about Z). Must satisfy 1.0 <= value < 100.0.

B2Y_DELTA_SY.description: B2y - Delta sy (Second Order Moment magnification factor about Y). Must satisfy 1.0 <= value < 100.0.

B2Z_DELTA_SZ.description: B2z - Delta sz (Second Order Moment magnification factor about Z). Must satisfy 1.0 <= value < 100.0.
